dataset.mechanism: true-env-leaf counterfactuals (851 _true_env_leaf_values, tail OFF): teacher + true-env-leaf-greedy walks x {gross,net@21}; K dithered-book candidates (hb=3.0) + policy-argmax; G=r0+gamma*V (R=3)
dataset.storage: RAM (numpy); no disk I/O in the train loop (efficiency invariant)

imprint.recipe: BC value regression v̂(g(s,a))->true R-step return; dynamics+value gradients only, policy/reward/encoder frozen (optax multi_transform); PopArt-normalized two-hot targets (shipped value-loss form)

calibration.instrument: 849 calibration column = MEAN PER-STATE Pearson of the predictor vs the true R-step return, across candidates WITHIN a state, meaned over HELD-OUT states (mean_per_state_pearson = PRIMARY; pooled_pearson = inflated secondary). Two predictors: 'vhat_alone' (the spec's literal (i)) and 'deployed_q' = r_model+gamma*v_hat (what the leaf actually ranks by — the honest deployment predictor + the one that tracks ranking-transfer). Real-leg bar +0.5 on HELD-OUT per-state; graded on the REAL panel by the planner.

deployed_q.note: r_model + gamma*v_hat — the DEPLOYED model-leaf ranking quantity; this (not vhat_alone) is what the (ii) fail-closed-safe floor keys on (see deployable_ranking_gate). It does NOT improve here (frozen reward head) and is within-noise/seed-dependent at fixture scale — the (ii) floor only rejects strong sabotage, it is NOT a lift/positive-validation claim.

deployment_predictor_gap.reason: frozen 832 reward head is a poor r0 estimator; drags the deployable ranking below the v̂-in-isolation calibration. Reward head = candidate next locus (planner decision; TASK_857 does not touch it).

deployable_ranking_gate.instrument: deployed-Q (r_model+gamma*v_hat) held-out MEAN PER-STATE Pearson vs the true-env per-candidate return G — the DEPLOYED leaf's ranking quantity. This MOVES with the value head (target-shuffle sabotage collapses it to ~-0.5), unlike argmax-choice agreement.
deployable_ranking_gate.gate: deployed_q held-out mean-per-state Pearson is finite AND > -0.25. FAIL-CLOSED-SAFE non-degeneracy floor: it rejects STRONG anti-correlation / --shuffle-targets sabotage (~-0.5) but is NOT a positive validation of deployed-ranking lift. The LEGITIMATE distill's absolute deployed-Q is within-noise and seed-dependent at fixture scale ({+0.115,-0.014,-0.119,+0.491} across seeds 0-3; frozen reward head gives no reliable lift) — so the floor sits below that band and above sabotage. The deployed-ranking VERDICT is the planner's real-data corridor read.
deployable_ranking_gate.seed_note: absolute deployed-Q is within-noise/seed-dependent at fixture scale; this floor is fail-closed-safe (rejects sabotage), NOT a lift claim.
deployable_ranking_gate.real_leg_bar: >=0.70 argmax-choice agreement on the real panel (planner's leg)

ranking_transfer.instrument: ARGMAX-choice agreement: v̂-leaf (model-leaf == eval_vector --leaf-eval vhat-distilled) vs true-env-leaf SELECTED-VECTOR agreement on held-out states (same rng => same candidate set; only the leaf differs). REPORTED DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — the spec's literal (ii); the >=70% bar is the planner's real-data leg. NOT discriminative at fixture scale: shared rng draws + the frozen reward head dominate SELECTION, so a good and a degenerate leaf both score ~58% (the fail-closed-safe (ii) floor is deployable_ranking_gate). chance = 100/M is an informational bound, not the acceptance gate.

deployable_read.note: the graded corridor read is a SCHEDULED planner run: eval_vector.py --operator search --leaf-eval vhat-distilled on the real panel vs floor +0.424 (first) / +8.02 true-leaf ceiling (honest reference). net_dependent=true (the v̂ leaf is the learned component, even at pw0).
